fabrication.primary_process: 5-axis/3+2 CNC machine upper frame from6061-T6 billet, datum fixtures then finish mating surfaces. Native segments are construction stock of one solid, not loose pieces. No welding or unqualified post-weldT6 assumption.
fabrication.post_fusion_cut_order: Load current updated native source shapes, fuse added stock, then apply fusion holes/slots to FINAL stock. Never fuse uncut beams over finishedTslots.
fabrication.T_slot_manufacture: Open-ended horizontalTslots; narrow neck cutters and undercut slitting/microTslot cutters from exposed front/rearfaces. Deburr; matched G10 keys slide in before retainerbars.
fabrication.G10_process: Machine each G10 keyed cap/guide as one piece; keep fibres and edges sealed. Hard compression acceptance>=25MPa at60C. No foam/printed polymer stop-land substitute.
fabrication.guide_precision: Finish matched assembled guide faces to X33.95/136.05 and163.95/266.05, gap102.10+/-0.02mm. Actual assembled key play is included in gauge acceptance. Original guide datum and lateral card acceptance unchanged.
fabrication.stop_precision: All eight finished lands topZ34.4. Matched/jig finish unchanged loadbearing facesZ33.4. G10 shoulder bearing area3.6mm2 gives50N/3.6=13.89MPa. STOP keyfoot32.0..32.5 in31.9..32.6 pocket, neck32.5..33.4; metalledge above pocket0.8mm, not0.4mm. Original loaded-stop assembly acceptance remains.
fabrication.threading: Eight1.6mm pilot holes through4mm beam walls, tapM2x0.4. Remove burrs. No plasticthreads or retainednut trap.
fabrication.retainer_centre_arm_relief: Each bar passes below the retained central arm through integral2mm-high bridgeZ25.4..27.4 and1.3mm-wide side risers;0.2mm lateral armclearance. No arm thinning or collisionwaiver. Frontbar leftedgeX28 gives2.5mm screw-axis edge distance atX30.5.

assembly_sequence: Machine frame, keyed G10 parts and two removablebars; retain source native mountingholes.
Match-fit guidekeys and stopkeys from open beamface, seat keys and install closurebars using8M2x6.
Finish/gauge unchanged stopZ34.4 and guidegap102.10+/-0.02 in assembly.
Locate four lowerG10 bearing strips on spreaderkeys, install PCB and retained lug stacks; source load-spreader and case anchor system unchanged.
Install completed upper frame on existing five fixed frameanchors; no roof wiring.
service_sequence: Remove both cartridges, four lid screws and lift unconnectedlid.
Release frame anchorfasteners in existing common BOM and unplug service obstructingJ61 only after frame is clear; passive cooling has no fan/shroud.
Lift upper frame as one assembly with captured caps/guides/retainerbars. Lower bearings remain located/captured by PCB until PCB is removed.
Replace keyedG10 parts only with frame removed, bar screws accessible horizontally. Re-gauge matched precision faces after replacement.
fabrication_release: Design completion, not a fabricated-prototype/torque/strength/thermal qualification claim.
